## #12 — frank beckmann — 2010-04-06
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/2581/post-41143>

Hi.
To keep the scripts over new updates put´em into: HD/User/YourName/Library/Application Suppot/Cheetah3d/scripts and from here into the approbate folders.
This one goes into the folder named "Polygonobj"

Cheers
Frank
